name: Winking
overview: Scripture presents winking as a gesture often associated with deceit, malice, and secretive scheming. For example, Proverbs warns that he who winks with the eye causes sorrow and devises froward things (Proverbs 10:10; 16:30). Job and Psalms highlight how winking can signify wrongful hatred or hidden intentions against others (Job 15:12; Psalms 35:19). Thus, biblical teaching cautions believers to avoid such behavior, emphasizing sincerity and integrity in contrast to the covert evil that winking can represent.
